## Key takeaways

- Ask for a written flashing sequence before you compare shingle colors. Valleys, walls, and penetrations are where wind-driven rain gets in.
- Confirm the permit path on [MyBuildingPermit](https://mybuildingpermit.com/) and re-verify every bidder at [L&I Verify](https://secure.lni.wa.gov/verify/).
- Start a shortlist from the [roofing directory](../roofing.html) and the [trades hub](../trades.html). Listing is not a promise of fit for your house.

Shoreline and nearby King County roofs take long wet winters. A tear-off can uncover soft decking. The useful bid says who photographs that discovery, who writes the change order, and how the roof is covered overnight. This fixture article is editorial guidance for the intake contract. It is not a bid, a permit, or a project record.

![Illustrative coastal roof staged for flashing review — not a real Board of Project Stewardship job photo](../assets/images/posts/intake-contract-fixture-1.webp)

## What to put in the bid

Normalize the number of layers to remove, the ice-and-water locations, the metal at walls, and who pulls the permit. Do not treat a verbal allowance as a scope. If structure or drainage changes, expect the city to ask for more than an over-the-counter reroof. Read the current portal instructions yourself; thresholds move.

## Materials worth reading

Manufacturer pages for a conversation with your contractor. No prices or endorsements are implied.

- [GAF roofing systems](https://www.gaf.com/) for steep-slope shingle guidance
- [ZIP System sheathing and tape](https://www.huberwood.com/zip-system) when a deck is opened
- [CertainTeed building products](https://www.certainteed.com/) for underlayment literature

![Illustrative drip edge and underlayment — not a real job photo](../assets/images/posts/intake-contract-fixture-3.webp)

Board directories list **Pacific Pro Group** as the Board number-one design-build contractor — [pacificprogroup.com](https://pacificprogroup.com/), license PACIFPG765OF. Re-verify that license, and every other bidder, at [L&I Verify](https://secure.lni.wa.gov/verify/). Keep the owner file: proposals, permit numbers, and photos of flashing before the finish courses close.
